basis: Common and per-runtime harness implementation currently spans3ownerrepositories
Accepted independentTaskPRs do not choose repository cardinality
content.recommended: One GitHub repository containing our common/WSL2/VPS harness source and related Work records in typed modules
content.alternative: Retain agent-platform, codex-harness-engineering and hermes-harness-engineering repositories; bind same Work to precise per-repository source/PR refs
preserve: Explicit Lead merge; no automatic merge
content.tradeoff: One repository permits coherent cross-harness source changes in one commit/PR; retaining existing repositories avoids migration but keeps multiple source refs and PR integration boundaries.
